CPV.note: A municipal finance application; no office connection stated.

facts.fact: Cabo Verde's Directorate-General for Decentralisation said Simpol would be applied from 2026-10-28 in all 22 municipalities to manage local finances and to prepare and collect the new property tax.
Municipal staff were trained on Simpol at a two-day event and the Directorate-General said it would be applied in all 22 municipalities.
The Ministry of State Reform, Local Power and Decentralisation, through its Directorate-General for Decentralisation, is introducing Simpol to the municipalities.
